test_summary.test_case: params object accepts null value without validation in POST /collections/{collection}/points/search
test_summary.expected_behavior: Should return 400 Bad Request - params is an object type, not nullable
test_summary.actual_behavior: Returns 200 OK with search results, silently treating null as 'no params'

threat_model_reference.description: REST API framework/serde assumes validation but null objects slip through

evidence.related_to_known_issues: Similar to #9418-9420 (null filter validation), same BS-01 pattern

validation.contract_specification: Contract states params is an object type (optional)
validation.api_documentation: Qdrant API docs specify params as optional object for search parameters

defect_details.should_reject_because: null is not a valid object value - type coercion/validation gap
defect_details.why_accepted: null treated as 'params not provided' instead of invalid type
defect_details.impact: API contract violation - invalid null type silently accepted

submission_readiness.justification: BS-01 pattern - nested object null validation gap, similar to historical filter null issues
